viewing_check: Look at back plate and movement for a maker's stamp or roundel (Drocourt, Duverdrey & Bloquel, Japy etc.; a named maker adds value); check for a strike or repeat button on the top or a second barrel, and an alarm dial; try winding and see if it runs; check for cracks in the enamel dial, hairlines, and chipped or missing glass.
rate_note: All prices are AUD hammer from the databases, no conversion. Noble and Leski hammer exclude premium.
